_comment: What it costs an Age's instability budget to open tears in its ground, and how far that goes
(design 5.0, 5.1). A seam is the world's shape being wrong, a wound is the world being holed. Each
step bought makes one likelier per chunk rather than adding a fixed count -- a handful of wounds in a
whole dimension is a handful nobody ever walks past.
Opens at 3, which is the fence that says a single slip tears seams and holes nothing.
